copy.en:
Foldable Phone Holder On Handle
The foldable holder keeps your phone visible while the two-zone interior separates travel essentials.
TSA combination lock supports customs inspection
Wet-dry pocket, zippered mesh pocket, and X-shaped straps
copy.zh:
拉杆配备可折叠手机支架
展开支架便于查看手机，双区内衬帮助分开收纳衣物与用品。
TSA密码锁便于海关查验
干湿分离袋、网格拉链袋与X型固定带
copy.de:
Klappbare Handyhalterung am Teleskopgriff
Die Halterung hält das Smartphone sichtbar; der Zwei-Zonen-Innenraum trennt Reiseutensilien.
TSA-Zahlenschloss erleichtert die Gepäckkontrolle
Nassfach, Netzfach mit Reißverschluss und X-förmige Packgurte
copy.fr:
Porte-téléphone pliable sur la poignée
Le support garde le téléphone visible, tandis que l’intérieur à deux zones sépare les affaires.
Serrure à combinaison TSA pour le contrôle des bagages
Poche humide-sèche, poche filet zippée et sangles en X
copy.it:
Supporto pieghevole per smartphone sul manico
Il supporto mantiene visibile lo smartphone; l’interno a due zone separa gli articoli da viaggio.
Serratura a combinazione TSA per i controlli bagagli
Tasca umido-asciutto, tasca a rete con cerniera e cinghie a X
copy.es:
Soporte plegable para teléfono en el mango
El soporte mantiene visible el teléfono; el interior de dos zonas separa los artículos de viaje.
Cerradura de combinación TSA para controles de equipaje
Bolsillo seco-húmedo, bolsillo de malla con cremallera y correas en X

design_brief_zh: 主卖点是“拉杆上的可折叠手机支架”，以手机可见、便于查看为购买理由；双区内衬、干湿分离袋、网格拉链袋与X型固定带提供可见的收纳证据，TSA密码锁作为独立细节说明其便于海关查验。PC画布2000×2000采用左文右产品：文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.10,0.38,0.80]，产品区[x,y,w,h]=[0.49,0.08,0.46,0.84]。PC阅读顺序严格为标题、支持说明、TSA锁细节、内部收纳细节；标题对应拉杆顶部展开的手机支架特写，支持说明对应手机放置状态与打开后的双区内衬，第三行对应箱体边缘的TSA密码锁局部，第四行对应打开箱体内部的干湿分离袋、网格拉链袋和X型固定带。产品以约45度角打开，拉杆伸出且支架处于展开状态，完整呈现双区内衬；手机应放在支架上但屏幕保持中性、无品牌界面。移动端1200×1200将产品区放在上方[x,y,w,h]=[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，文案区放在下方[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.64,0.90,0.31]，按相同四行顺序重新排版，德语预留约20%横向扩展空间。使用欧洲现代旅行摄影、低饱和中性色与自然光；柔和侧上方光线突出箱体竖条纹、铝合金边框、手机支架、锁具和内衬分区，避免反光遮挡结构。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题最大，支持说明次之，两个细节为短标签；TSA、双区、干湿分离袋、网格拉链袋和X型固定带需清晰可辨。
compliance_note_zh: 仅展示已提供的可折叠手机支架、双区内衬、干湿分离袋、网格拉链袋、X型固定带和TSA密码锁；“便于查看手机”属于结构带来的直观使用收益，“便于海关查验”不得延伸为保证更快通关。不得暗示官方背书、绝对安全、认证、测试、防水、静音或其他未提供性能。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium European modern travel photography image of a YWJ 13A hard-shell suitcase, shown at a clean 45-degree angle and opened, with the telescopic handle extended and its foldable phone holder clearly unfolded holding a neutral smartphone with no visible brand interface. Show the complete two-zone polyester interior: one side with a wet-dry separation pocket and a zippered mesh pocket, the other side with clothing secured by X-shaped straps. Include a natural close detail of the TSA combination lock on the suitcase edge. Use low-saturation neutral colors, soft natural side-top lighting, and controlled reflections that reveal the vertical shell texture, aluminum frame, phone holder, lock, and interior organization. PC composition: suitcase and visual proof on the right within approximately x=0.49,y=0.08,w=0.46,h=0.84; reserve a clean, uncluttered text area on the left within x=0.05,y=0.10,w=0.38,h=0.80. Mobile composition: product in the upper area x=0.08,y=0.05,w=0.84,h=0.53 and a clean text area below x=0.05,y=0.64,w=0.90,h=0.31. Arrange visual emphasis in reading order: foldable phone holder, phone visibility and two-zone interior, TSA lock, then the three interior organization features. Do not render any text, labels, logos, icons, badges, or decorative claims in the image.
